title: Zainab meri behna
body:
Zainab meri behna
Zainab meri behna
Zainab meri behna
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye sheh ne kaha
<<MINI>>
Zainab meri behna, dukhya meri behna
<<DIVIDER>>
Lawt kar shaam ke, zindaan se jab aanaa zainab
Tum mere kabr pe, ik shamaa jalaana zainab
Yaad rakhna ye baat, ay meri jaan, meri behna
<<MINI>>
Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna
Tum fateha sharbat pe dilana meri behna
Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna
<<DIVIDER>>
Gham mere azadar manayenge jahaa me, (ay meri behna) x2
Percham kahi taabut kahi hongi sabile, (ay meri behna) x2
Majlis me sabilo pe bhi jaana meri behna
<<MINI>>
Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna
Tum fateha sharbat pe dilana meri behna
(Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Matam jo azadar kare farshe azaa par, (ay meri behna) x2
Wo ashk bahaaye jo masayib mere sunkar, (ay meri behna) x2
Daman me un ashko ko chupana meri behna
<<MINI>>
Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna
Tum fateha sharbat pe dilana meri behna
(Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas ke parcham ko sajaaye jo azadar, (ay meri behna) x2
Bacho ko mera sakaa banaaye jo azadar, (ay meri behna) x2
Abbas ko darya se bulana meri behna
<<MINI>>
Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna
Tum fateha sharbat pe dilana meri behna
(Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jula mere besheer ka phoolo se sajaa kar, (ay meri behna) x2
Mannat koyi mane muje awlaad ataa kar, (ay meri behna) x2
Us bibi ki agosh sajaana meri behna
<<MINI>>
Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna
Tum fateha sharbat pe dilana meri behna
(Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab bibiya tabut sakina ka uthaye, (ay meri behna) x2
Aur nawha sakina ke asiri ka sunaye, (ay meri behna) x2
Tabut pe tum baali charhana meri behna
<<MINI>>
Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna
Tum fateha sharbat pe dilana meri behna
(Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis ghar se uthe kasime naushah ki mehndi, (ay meri behna) x2
Aa rasta ashko se kare majlise shaadi, (ay meri behna) x2
Us ghar ko masa'ib se bachaana meri behna
<<MINI>>
Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna
Tum fateha sharbat pe dilana meri behna
(Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Agar koyi behen apne baradar se bichar kar, (ay meri behna) x2
Nawha ye kare lawt ke aajaa ali akber, (ay meri behna) x2
Us behen ko bhayi se milana meri behna
<<MINI>>
Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna
Tum fateha sharbat pe dilana meri behna
(Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch aur abhi tumko rulayenge sitam gar, (ay meri behna) x2
Khaymo ko mere baad jalaayenge sitam gar, (ay meri behna) x2
Sajaad ko sholo se bachaana meri behna
<<MINI>>
Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna
Tum fateha sharbat pe dilana meri behna
(Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab loot ka samaan mile kayd sitam me, (ay meri behna) x2
Majlis ka wahaa farsh bichaana mere gham me, (ay meri behna) x2
Zinadaan ko azaa khanaa banana meri behna
<<MINI>>
Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna
Tum fateha sharbat pe dilana meri behna
(Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Miljayengi jab mujko masayib se rihaayi, (haye hussaina) x2
Me fateha sharbat pe dilawungi ay bhayi, (haye hussaina) x2
Ha yaad he bhaya wo muje aap ka kehna
<<MINI>>
Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna
Tum fateha sharbat pe dilana meri behna
(Zainab meri behna dukhya meri behna) x2
